# `PromptVisibilityInterface`

`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp\Visibility\PromptVisibilityInterface`

**Interface** — [`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp`](/packages/core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp/blob/master/src/Visibility/PromptVisibilityInterface.php)

Per-session prompt visibility: filters prompts/list AND fail-closed guards
prompts/get — a hidden prompt cannot be fetched even by its exact name
(it is reported as not found, indistinguishable from a missing one). One
implementation serves both paths so list and get can never disagree.

## Methods

### isVisible()

```php
isVisible(
    Mcp\Schema\Prompt $prompt,
    ?Mcp\Server\Session\SessionInterface $session,
): bool
```
